# HSelect

> A native select with labeled options, not a recreated browser picker.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This reference describes repository source; package.json version: 0.2.0. Match it to the source/release you are using.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HSelect` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-select>`.
- Individual constructor: `HearthSelectElement` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Controls.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HSelect.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Prefer this native select for a short, fixed set that does not need search.
- Supply options as an array property, not a JSON attribute. Values are strings. Use placeholder with required when an explicit initial choice is needed.

## Public API

modelValue, value, label, name, placeholder, hint, error: string · options: {value, label, disabled?}[] · required, disabled: boolean

A `?` marks optional source props. A prop with a default may be omitted even when the source type is required. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    modelValue?: string;
    value?: string;
    label: string;
    name?: string;
    options: SelectOption[];
    placeholder?: string;
    hint?: string;
    error?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{ value: "", options: () => [] }
```

### Events

update:modelValue(value), change(value)

```ts
type Emits = {
    "update:modelValue": [
        value: string
    ];
    change: [
        value: string
    ];
};
```

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose arguments as `event.detail`, an array. Listen directly on the element. Native DOM events such as `click` keep their normal payloads.

### Slots

None

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Custom elements do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base, label, control, hint

Use `hearth-select::part(part-name)` for an exposed part, or inherited `--h-*` tokens for system-level styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Supporting types

```ts
export interface SelectOption {
    value: string;
    label: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
}
```

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { HSelect } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/styles.css';
const category = ref('media');
const options = [{ value: 'media', label: 'Media' }, { value: 'home', label: 'Home' }];
</script>

<template>
  <HSelect v-model="category" label="Category" name="category" :options="options" />
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point (use a `form` instead of `div` when demonstrating field submission):

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

The following is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a stylesheet link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Set array/object properties before connection when they should become reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-select');
Object.assign(element, {
  "label": "Category",
  "name": "category",
  "value": "media",
  "options": [
    {
      "value": "media",
      "label": "Media"
    },
    {
      "value": "home",
      "label": "Home"
    }
  ]
});
element.addEventListener('change', event => {
  const [value] = event.detail;
  // Update your application state using value.
});
mount.append(element);
```

## Related components

- [HCombobox](../combobox/llms.txt): Searchable single or multi-select with selected chips, disabled options, keyboard navigation, and repeated form values.
- [HMultiSelect](../multi-select/llms.txt): An array-typed multi-select combobox using the same searchable selection engine as HCombobox.
- [HRadioGroup](../radio-group/llms.txt): One native radio group per component, with descriptions, disabled choices, and arrow/Home/End keyboard control.
